title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 57 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 57)

content.overview: Section 57 sets out the statutory conditions for enforcement of Geneva Convention foreign awards, including validity, notice and opportunity, scope of submission, composition/procedure, binding status and the statutory public-policy and arbitrability limitations.
